title: Approval process with a decision
text: An employee submits a request; if the amount is over 1000 the manager approves it, otherwise it is approved automatically; then finance pays.
why: Steps left to right, the condition as a diamond with labelled yes / no arrows, start and end as ellipses.

args.code:
flowchart LR
  S([Request]) --> A{Over 1000?}
  A -->|yes| B[Manager approves]
  A -->|no| C[Auto-approved]
  B --> D[Finance pays]
  C --> D
  D --> E([Done])
